scope: Native immediate AND for AH/CH/DH/BH using existing byte arithmetic flags

qualification.focusedCoverage: All 256 input byte values, five immediate masks including measured 0xfd, all four high-byte registers, baseline and optimizing tiers; interpreter equivalence plus explicit surrounding-bit preservation.

mixedInstructionRegression.sequence: mov rdx,constant; and dh,0xfd; mov rax,rdx
mixedInstructionRegression.before: Optimizing tier incorrectly propagated the old full-register constant; regression reproduced.
mixedInstructionRegression.after: High-byte writes invalidate the full-register constant. Baseline and optimizing tiers preserve the changed value.

limitations: Other high-byte operations remain interpreter fallbacks.
